nbbb842ee1c.headline: World Bank suspends loans to Mozambique due to hidden debt
nbbb842ee1c.summary: The World Bank has suspended loans to Mozambique pending a joint debt sustainability assessment with the IMF due to undisclosed debt issues.
nbbb842ee1c.why: Mozambique's debt problems and suspension of World Bank loans raise concerns about fiscal stability and creditworthiness, affecting investment and aid flows.
nbbb842ee1c.why_moved: The loan suspension reflects concerns over Mozambique's fiscal health, likely increasing risk perceptions and affecting sovereign credit markets.
